title: Testing a cute pixel unicorn platformer — does the jump timing feel satisfying?
author: Fearless_Shift7108

comments.author: friboy
comments.body: This is flappy bird with a unicorn rewrap theme, to put it softly, no but maybe try to add your own addition onto it that would add to the original game experience.

replies.author: Fearless_Shift7108
replies.body: thanks for saying it directly. This is still a very early gameplay test, so we’re trying to figure out what would make it feel more original beyond the basic tap-to-fly loop. We’ll definitely explore adding mechanics that create a different experience rather than just a visual re-theme.

replies.body: Try not the flappy bird loop. "Tap to fly" yeah and the tubes and everything else.

replies.author: kytheon
replies.body: Half the games here are clones cause it's not made by gamedevs.

comments.author: derAres
comments.body: It will gain drastically if you use a full body unicorn with animated flapping wings. An animated gif would do.

replies.author: Fearless_Shift7108
replies.body: Good idea! The character could definitely feel more alive with a full-body unicorn design and animated flapping wings. We’re still in the early stage, so this is exactly the kind of feedback we’re looking for.

replies.author: derAres
replies.body: You’re welcome :) … we? How big is your team building this flappy bird clone 😁

replies.author: Fearless_Shift7108
replies.body:
Thanks again 😄 By “we,” I mean our small team — around a dozen people. We’re building a game platform, and this is just one of the mini-game concepts we’re testing.

Totally fair that it feels too close to Flappy Bird right now. We’re still experimenting with more gameplay ideas to make it feel more original.

comments.author: barret232hxc
comments.body:
i think the jumping looks good. I think a way to expand on the gameplay maybe is to add a dash to break trough things or quickly go through a gap. I have fond memories of playing robot unicorn attack that game was so fun. check it out for some inspiration maybe [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eEIxMmsd548](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eEIxMmsd548)

so adding a dash with cool down would add a lot ( maybe with a rainbow trail effect that is alphaed out to have kinda like a ghost trail effect, you could even add enemies that you have to dash through. or you could make this like a flappy bird with some shmup DNA mixed with vampire survivors upgrades. you collect a currency get enough get your classic 3 choices that level up your unicorn and start fighting enemie having spinning things around your unicorn shooting projectiles. I mean you could actually have a lot of fun making the flappy bird gameplay feel more leveled up, and it could be less of a rage game possibly. but that's just my ideas. 

so the complexity added is really just 2 buttons

one for jump   
one for dash

then all the other stuff if you go the shmup would just be auto attack stuff. Also don't let people poop on your work. Sure it's a flappy bird clone, but if you don't have a traditional gamedev background this is a great place to start, something simple that you can work with. I mean a lot of gamedevs would clone known games just to learn and figure stuff out so I think this is a great start. Keep going

replies.author: Fearless_Shift7108
replies.body:
This is super helpful, thank you. A dash with cooldown actually sounds like a simple but meaningful way to move it beyond a basic tap-to-fly loop.

The rainbow trail idea also fits the unicorn theme really well. I like the thought of mixing a simple jump/dash control with light shmup or upgrade mechanics, where the player can gradually feel more powerful instead of just surviving gaps.

We’ll probably test a version with:

* jump + dash
* rainbow trail feedback
* enemies or breakable objects
* simple upgrade choices after collecting currency

Really appreciate the detailed ideas — this is exactly the kind of feedback we were hoping for.
